body.x: CES 2023 is just around the corner to welcome tech enthusiasts, innovators, traders, and writers around the world. Las Vegas in the United States will become the epicenter of tech issues and interests headlining next year, during January 5~8th, 2023. Visitors would expect companies in different sizes to standout on main stages, centered at Las Vegas Convention Center, Venetian Expo, and ARIA Resort. For those who like to gain more connection along with the main CES experience, networking events await them. AVING News recommends following 10 events to visit during the week of CES 2023. (All time is PST)

body.cap: View of Park MGM, the location of this event (Photo by Tomás Del Coro)

body.x: Fortune Brainstorm Tech Dinner 2023
When: January 4th, 2023 @ 6PM~
Where: NoMad Library at Park MGM (3772 S Las Vegas Blvd Las Vegas, NV 89109)

The Fortune hosts its pre-CES annual dinner event in Las Vegas to talk about how the landscape of tech innovation and invention will shape in the year ahead. Its Brainstorm Tech conversation this year will focus on the topic “Climate Tech: New Frontiers”, at NoMad Library in the Park MGM Las Vegas. They will discuss over Climate Tech, the energy decarbonization, and the innovation’s role in keeping promises of the Paris Agreement. Bill Gross – the founder of Heliogen and Idealab - and Rushad Nanavatty – Managing Director of Rocky Mountain Institute – will speak along staffs from Fortune. They will share their thoughts on next clean tech unicorns, tech industry’s journey to accomplish sustainability goals, and sustainable cooperation between the industry and the policy.
https://fortune.com/conferences/fortune-brainstorm-tech-dinner-2023/
CES 2023 Crypto Happy Hour Presented by Vegas Crypto Group
When: January 4th, 2023 @ 6PM~10PM
Where: The Nerd Bar (450 E. Fremont Street Las Vegas, NV 89101)

Vegas Crypto Group, the local crypto meetup group, organizes the free-for-all (with reservation) socializing event concentrating on Web3 technology. In accordance with CES, the event will gather enthusiasts and startups in Web3 industry – including cryptocurrency and blockchain – along with hacktivists. Notable invitee companies include Tech Alley, Aspire, MakerDAO, Flote.app, Ledgerback, PraSaga and Ballet Wallet.
https://www.meetup.com/vegas-crypto-meetup/events/289846000/
Meet the K-Startup @ CES 2023 & K-STARTUP DEMO DAY Award in CES 2023
When: January 5th, 2023 @ 10AM~ / January 6th, 2023 @ 2PM~3PM
Where: Booth# 62032, Tech West Eureka Park at The Venetian Expo (1st Floor Hall G)

Korean Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development (KISED) will host the networking party and demo day award at its booth. On January 5th, 10AM, KISED will conduct the opening ceremony. On January 6th, the booth will host K-Startup Demo Day – where aspiring 10 Korean startups will pitch for global market expansion. On January 7th, after the Global Startup Talk Show on 2PM, Global Media Award judging on the Demo Day participants begins on 4PM. The networking party, Meet the K-Startup, starts along with the award ceremony.
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/k-startup-demo-day-in-ces-2023-tickets-490354051167?aff=ebdssbdestsearch
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/meet-the-k-startup-ces-2023-tickets-494525999577?aff=eprofsaved

body.x: Seoul Tech Pavillion Keynote Speech @ CES 2023
When: January 5th, 2023 @ 1PM~3PM
Where: Booth# 10435, North Hall at the Las Vegas Convention Center

The Seoul Metropolitan City will open Seoul Technology Pavilion at LVCC North Hall of CES 2023 – presenting innovative technology related to mobility, ESG, etc. For the first time in CES history, a pavilion by a government entity will showcase at the North Hall - usually an exhibition space for leading tech companies like Samsung. With “Smart Traffic City, Green City, Seoul” as its main theme, renown 12 Korean companies like Lotte and Hancom will also present at the Pavilion.
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/media-invitation-to-seoul-tech-pavillion-keynote-speech-ces-2023-tickets-500259458507?aff=ebdssbdestsearch
Dealmakers @ CES 2023
When: January 5th, 2023 @ 12PM~11PM
Where: Tech West Eureka Park at The Venetian Expo

Landmark Ventures hosts its annual Dealmakers @ CES event consisting of 5 networking events over 11 hours. All events will bring experts and high-profile officers in digital ecosystem – including marketing, eCommerce, advertising, social impact, etc. Guests can expect business leaders to explore trends, build connections, and predict what’s next on digital engagement together.
12PM – VIP Power Lunch: Consumer Marketing & Brand Engagement
3:30PM – Dealmakers Happy Hour: ESG, Climate & Sustainability Tech
5PM – VIP Dinner: CSR, ESG & Social Impact
5PM – VIP Dinner: Sports, Media & Entertainment
8PM – Late Night with Landmark
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfYAWU0aT9AwpD63q5ypJb4fUzCJVVQT1r-3NNzCwnh0ByfXA/viewform
VR/AR Professionals CES Meetup
When: January 6th, 2023 @ 6:30PM~10:30PM
Where: To be disclosed from the host after registration in the link below

VR video player developer DeoVR will host the light meetup headlined by virtual reality, with food and drink on its side. Designed to provide sanctuary for tired show participants, this meetup welcomes VR/AR enthusiasts with the newest version of VR platform. For regular participants in CES, DeoVR also offers $100 off CES registration exhibitor code on its registration page.
https://lu.ma/deovr

body.x: Startup of the Year Coffee Meetup at CES 2023
When: January 6th, 2023 @ 8AM~10AM
Where: Off the Strip restaurant at LINQ Promenade (3535 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109)

Established, the consultancy assisting companies with their strategies, will host the breakfast meetup for startup industry. Founders, investors, ecosystem builders, and those covering startups are welcome to join this event. Established also welcomes visitors at the Small Business Administration Booth #61401 at Eureka Park and will present the winner of the CTA Foundation Pitch Competition the prize – the right to be featured as part of its Startup of the Year Podcast.
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/startup-of-the-year-coffee-meetup-at-ces-2023-tickets-477045304347

body.x: Hong Kong Reception @CES 2023
When: January 6th, 2023 @ 6PM~8PM
Where: Trustworthy Brewing Co. (3377 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109)

The Hong Kong Association of Northern California – a non-profit business organization – invites all to this networking event with business leaders and entrepreneurs from Hong Kong. This event will promote the Hong Kong Pavilion at CES 2023, in Design & Source section and Eureka Park. 22 companies from the HK Pavilion will share their innovations and trends to founders and visitors at CES in a more compact and direct meetup.
https://www.hkanc.com/events/hong-kong-reception-ces-2023

body.x: CES Meetup & Hangout @ Retro Arcade Bar
When: January 6th, 2023 @ 6PM~8PM
Where: Player 1 Video Game Bar – Las Vegas (2797 South Maryland Parkway #24 Las Vegas, NV 89109)

Beep! Digital, the brand and marketing design agency, hosts tech minded gamer friendly networking event at the classic arcade place. Along with unlimited access to nostalgic arcade machines, the event will provide an abundant selection from craft breweries all over the United States. With $10 admission fee, guests can enjoy the vibrant environment, with the screening of short film Power Surge 2 – inspired by the 90s subculture.
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/ces-meetup-hangout-retro-arcade-bar-power-surge-your-networking-tickets-477236716867
2nd Annual United by Play Battle for Charity
When: January 5th, 2023 @ 10AM ~ 6PM
Where: HyperX Arena Las Vegas at Luxor Hotel & Casino (3900 S. Las Vegas Blvd Las Vegas, NV 89119)

ViewSonic hosts the annual charity Esports tournament for the 2nd time, following last year’s CES. Reserved participants can observe intense and exciting Valorant tournament with professional gamers, influencers, and streamers competing for generosity. This live event streaming on Twitch will raise money for the Starlight Children’s Foundation, Stack Up Military Charity, Be the Match, LANFEST, and more. Notable celebrities competing include TacticalGramma, 56-year-old FPS streamer, and RowdyRogan, 8-year-old gaming YouTuber. Guests will receive exclusive gift bags by tournament sponsors, and can donate for winning exclusive prizes like gaming consoles, monitors, PCs and more.
https://www.viewsonic.com/us/unitedbyplay2023-rsvp-tournament
